orchestrator.description: Runs the acme-api phase loop: scope, implement, merge, finish. One unit at a time.

agents.name: scope
agents.description: Reads the current roadmap phase and returns one or two packets, each with a model. Does not edit the tree.

agents.name: implement
agents.description: Implements one scope packet on a branch, runs check and review until clean, and hands off. Does not merge. The parent passes the model.

agents.name: check
agents.description: Runs local acme-api checks and returns a short green or red summary. Launched by implement and finish.

agents.name: review
agents.description: Reviews one branch diff for real defects and returns findings. Launched by implement.

agents.name: merge
agents.description: Compares one finished branch to the spec and squash-merges it into local main. No push.

agents.name: finish
agents.description: Checks one roadmap phase against its exit criteria and returns finished or open. Launched by the orchestrator.
